# Agentivity

> Agentivity is a platform to build teams of AI agents, without code. You describe each AI specialist in plain words, choose how they work together, and hand them the job. The team does the work and comes back to a person for every decision that is theirs. The Community edition is free forever and runs on your own server (Docker), with your own key from your AI model provider (bring your own key). A cloud edition is coming; there is a waitlist.

Key facts:

- A chatbot answers. A team does the work. Agentivity builds teams of AI agents, workflows with human approval, and VibeApps: applications that adapt to the person who uses them, with a team behind.
- Built in the Studio, in the browser: by describing what you need to the Assistant, or by hand on a canvas. No code.
- Five ways for a team to work together: Sequential, Concurrent, Handoff, Group chat and Manager-led. A team can have another team or a workflow as a member.
- Workflows: fixed steps (forms, conditions, loops, approvals by a person, AI steps). AI works only in the steps you choose.
- Knowledge Bases (your own texts, searched by meaning, on your server) and Data Tables (rows your agents and workflows read and fill).
- Prompt Studio: write, test and improve the instructions of an agent.
- AI model providers: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, xAI, DeepSeek and AWS Bedrock, each with your own key. No markup on tokens.
- Licence: source-available, under the Elastic License 2.0. Code on GitHub; image on Docker Hub.
- Made by SMART PIXEL BV. Website in English and French.

## Product

- [How it works](https://www.agentivity.io/how-it-works/): describe a team to the Assistant, or build it by hand in the Studio
- [Teams](https://www.agentivity.io/teams/): AI specialists that work together, and the five ways of working
- [Agents](https://www.agentivity.io/agents/): one AI specialist with a role, its tools, its knowledge and its model
- [Workflows](https://www.agentivity.io/workflows/): the same steps every time, with a person who approves
- [Prompt Studio](https://www.agentivity.io/prompt-studio/): test and improve the instructions of an agent
- [Knowledge & Data](https://www.agentivity.io/knowledge-and-data/): Knowledge Bases and Data Tables for your agents
- [VibeApps](https://www.agentivity.io/vibeapps/): applications that adapt to the person, with an AI team behind them
- [Assistant](https://www.agentivity.io/assistant/): build an agent, a team or a workflow by describing it
- [Use cases](https://www.agentivity.io/use-cases/): Trip Planner, Shopping Lab, CV Screening
- [Pricing](https://www.agentivity.io/pricing/): the Community edition is free forever
- [Install the Community edition](https://www.agentivity.io/community/): Docker, on your own server
